period_policy: One fixed full-period evaluation only after quality/coverage/contamination gates pass. Never truncate or extend in response to PnL. If previously strategy-scored, this period cannot be an independent OOS: mark CONTAMINATED and register a different untouched period BEFORE scoring; do not silently relabel.
instrument: Individual E-mini Nasdaq-100 quarterly contracts, one NQ per trade, independent strategy ledgers, no portfolio aggregation or compounding
cost_accounting: Subtract fixed 1.225 points from raw fill gross PnL once per roundtrip; do not add slippage again to prices.
pass_rule_origin: Unchanged numeric criteria from research/holdout-protocol.json. All must pass on the primary OOS all-view alone. Minimum 20 is a computational floor, not a power guarantee and not permission to select a 20-day subsample.

inference.p_value: Two-sided centered bootstrap: (1 + count(abs(resampled_mean - observed_mean) >= abs(observed_mean))) / 2001
inference.ci: Nominal percentile 95% interval of resampled daily mean; p and CI need not be exact inverses. Both pass conditions required.
inference.daily_series: Chronological eligible dates, zero for no trade, no fictitious calendar-gap days; no historical discovery PnL in OOS inference
inference.multiplicity: One confirmatory primary; no correction needed within that single family. No reference/subgroup may be promoted based on this run. Any optional inferential reference family must be declared before scoring and globally Holm-corrected, otherwise descriptive only. Existing retrospective 16-test Holm audit remains frozen.

rollover.future_rule: For successive chronological quarterly contracts, irreversible first boundary-qualified completed civil session with incoming observed minute-volume SUM strictly greater than outgoing. Switch at 18:00 NY preceding the next expected nonclosed session, never intraday. Ties retain old. No return/PnL used.
rollover.boundary_qualification: Same as frozen holdout_data.rollovers: outgoing covers expected first and last minute; incoming starts no later than expected first +60 minutes and ends no earlier than expected last -60 minutes. Internal gaps remain audited separately, do not claim full CME totals.
rollover.missing_evidence: If overlap cannot establish crossover before expiry, no guessed/calendar fallback; stop with DATA_INSUFFICIENT before scoring. Record roll ledger and hashes before signals.
rollover.spread: Incoming close minus outgoing close at last common completed 15:59 NY minute strictly before activation. Not official settlement. No common close => stop. Store timestamp, availability and age; no future close or future roll used.
rollover.continuity: At each as-of session use only known cumulative additive spreads. Internally base=raw-known_offset; translate historical PDH/PDL to current raw basis. Use only for multi-day ATR/PDH/PDL. Never alter raw OHLCV, session VWAP, entries, exits or costs.
rollover.volume: For each NY clock minute median last at most 20 prior OBSERVED active-session volumes, minimum 10; update only after current session references computed. No inactive/current/future session volume. Strict >1.5x signal volume threshold unchanged.
rollover.positions: Flat by noon; no overnight or cross-contract positions, no rollover-gap signals.
rollover.availability_limit: Prior-session minute-volume totals assumed available before next 18:00 open; vendor publication-vintage not independently certified. Missing availability evidence prevents an unqualified real-time execution claim.

quality_and_eligibility: Frozen engine.hypotheses: positive prior ATR and complete exact-minute 18:00 previous NY calendar date through 12:00 current date; ORB additionally all 09:30-11:00 minute-volume references nonnull. Primary all-view includes flagged days only if required windows complete. Report clean sensitivity without replacing primary. No imputation. Official holidays/early closes and DST require dated calendar evidence locked before signals.
warmup: Carry historical active ATR TR and same-clock volume state through Sep 30; unscored prefix only. No post-Sep data in historical outputs. ATR last 14 valid completed RTH true ranges, complete current and immediately preceding RTH required. Initial lack of history stays ineligible, never substitute.

strategy_rules.ORB15: Range [09:30,09:45) NY. First completed bar timestamp in [09:45,11:00) closing strictly above/below range, volume strictly >1.5x prior same-clock median and close strictly on directional session VWAP side. Entry next exact minute open. One trade/day.
strategy_rules.ORB5_reference: Same rule with [09:30,09:35) range and [09:35,11:00) signals.
strategy_rules.London_reference: London [03:00,08:30). Sweep strictly outside high/low in [08:30,10:15); strict close back inside then directional completed-close VWAP cross same or later bar while inside. Skip same-bar double-direction qualification. First executable signal/day.
strategy_rules.VWAP_reference: First executable |session VWAP z|>2 completed close in [10:30,11:30); fade z direction toward VWAP frozen at signal; target must remain profitable at next open.
strategy_rules.session_vwap: 18:00 NY anchored volume-weighted HLC3 mean and population weighted HLC3 SD; not trade-level VWAP.
strategy_rules.risk_and_fills: Stop distance floor-to-.25 grid of .25*prior ATR, min .25; A/B target ceil-to-.25 of .50*ATR, min .25. VWAP absolute target floor for long/ceil for short. Stop/target inclusive. Simultaneous SL+TP => stop. Adverse gap stop at worse open; target capped. Unhit position closes at 11:59 minute close. Complete entry-through-noon path required.
strategy_rules.features: Prior-day and overnight context, RVOL14 and tick-null handling remain as frozen context.py. Features descriptive only, no new filter, sizing, direction choice, exit or threshold. Source has no tick counts.

post_entry: Keep volume_path.trade_paths rules: 1R raw entry-initial stop before costs; completed earlier bars plus execution endpoint lower bound, exit-bar full extrema upper bound capped by barriers; time labels minutes not tick ordering; zero excursion at time 0. Pure description, not new exits.
mandatory_reporting: expected/observed/eligible dates and reasons, calendar and raw hashes
top3 share and removal, cost stresses RT44.50/64.50 descriptive
primary bootstrap CI/p, long/short and monthly descriptive
MFE/MAE and path bounds, not simulated tick certainty
decision: DATA_INSUFFICIENT or CONTAMINATED => no valid independent verdict. All gates and all primary pass rules => HOLDOUT_PASSED for this protocol only, not live-trading approval. Adequate valid data but any primary pass rule false => HOLDOUT_FAILED. No rescue via combined history, best reference, subgroup, alternate costs or clean-view selection.
implementation_boundary: Existing runners are intentionally hardcoded to historical dataset. Future date/contract/calendar adapter is NOT implemented or executed here. It must preserve all frozen hashes/tests, prove parity on synthetic and historical fixtures and lock input/roll/calendar ledgers before any future scoring. Any semantic strategy change requires another version and a new untouched OOS.
